answer: New identities anchor to a basalt slab in the oasis registry: each locks a 55,000 POA bond into a slab carved only by a verified job for a real counterparty, and the carving is rechecked each epoch by a nebula of three rotating auditors staking their own bonds. A fake carving cracks the slab: the bond burns, half goes to the reporter, the identity is banned 13 epochs, slot revoked. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 × 55,000 = 55,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond of 55,000 POA once. The limit: slabs fill slowly, so honest newcomers queue when the oasis is crowded.
